items.title: Michael Moore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: And a friend of mine, Dave Matthews, was writing for James Brown, he was his arranger.

ctx.x: Did you ever play electric bass?

I did. Actually when I came to New York, everybody said well if you’re going to work you’d better play electric bass. I had just bought one and brought it to New York. And a friend of mine, Dave Matthews, was writing for James Brown, he was his arranger. And so I’m actually on some James Brown records.
